item.title: Poll: Idahoans don’t want Trump’s Bureau of Land Management nominee confirmed, citing public lands
item.description: BOISE, Idaho — A majority of Idaho voters oppose the appointment of proposed Bureau of Land Management chief Steve Pearce, and disapprove of his views on public lands and his ties to the oil and gas industry, according to a poll commissioned by a local nonprofit.

item.title: Your baby could qualify for $1,000 with a Trump Account. Here’s what to know
item.description: As a continuation of President Donald Trump 's pitch to Americans on affordability and the economy under his administration, the U.S. Treasury and White House are celebrating the upcoming launch of a program they view as a key milestone: Trump Accounts.

item.title: Starbucks sees room to expand with hundreds of new U.S. stores and increased seating
item.description: NEW YORK — Starbucks said Thursday that it plans to open hundreds of new stores across the U.S. and add seating capacity at thousands of existing locations, doubling down on a strategy of emphasizing the company's cafes as community hubs even as consumer demand for drive-thru coffee grows.

item.title: Football merger of 2A Greater St. Helens League, 2A Evergreen Conference will go forward after decision by District Directors
item.description: The merger for football only of the 2A Greater St. Helens League and 2A Evergreen Conference will go forward after a decision by the WIAA District Directors on the matter Thursday.

item.title: After a day of sharp swings, Wall Street ends nearly where it began
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — A day of dramatic swings on Wall Street, including Microsoft’s worst drop in years and a sudden reversal for the price of gold, finished with only relatively modest moves on Thursday.

item.title: Family in Kentucky shelters struggling calf born amid extreme cold temperatures
item.description: LOUISVILLE, Ky. — A Kentucky family battling extreme cold temperatures on their farm over the weekend opened their home to a newborn calf that was struggling in the deep freeze.

item.title: Out for the count: Annual Point-in-Time Count aims to tally Clark County’s homeless population
item.description: By 7 a.m. Thursday, Council for the Homeless outreach worker Brian Starbuck had already clocked several hours of work. It was still dark as he moved through east Vancouver to survey people living outside for the annual Point-in-Time Count, a one-day effort each January to tally Clark County’s homeless population.

item.title: Authorities: Man impersonating FBI agent tries to get Luigi Mangione out of jail
item.description: NEW YORK — A man falsely claiming to be an FBI agent showed up to a federal jail in New York City on Wednesday night and told officers he had a court order to release Luigi Mangione, authorities said.

item.title: Prep Sports Roundup: R.A. Long boys basketball clinch another 2A Greater St. Helens League title with win over Woodland
item.description: Jeff Rooklidge scored 16 points as R.A. Long pulled away in the second half to beat Woodland 64-57 and clinch the 2A Greater St. Helens League boys basketball title on Thursday in Woodland.
